page.overview:
Who is Cottla?

When initially asks if she would like to play, she will refuse, claiming that she and her mother are already in the middle of a game. She will then head up to the to search for the her mother. By 8:00 AM, gives up and goes to meet with the rest of her family. At 8:30 in the morning, will sit at the base of a near a fork in the road, wondering if her other family members will come by. At around 9:00 AM, will join her. After speaks with for the first time, will start to join them at this time.

While they sit together, shares stories with his children. tells them about how one can hear a woman sobbing in the woods past the , but he is actually just trying to scare them away from the woods, which have become full of . However, only becomes excited by the story instead of being fearful.

At 11:00 AM, and will get up and go their separate ways, running through as returns to work. Even in the , can be found running about. If speaks to her during this time, she will declare that she is bored and wonder when dinner will be. Should he immediately say goodbye, she will be disappointed.

If asks if she would like to play with him, she will be excited at once, causing her to ask what he would like to play. For games, can choose between Tag or Hide-and-seek. Choosing Tag excites further and she begins to run in place. Choosing Hide-and-seek makes declare that she will hide while seeks her. Before she leaves, she lets know that they will have to stop the game at dinnertime. Selecting a game and agreeing to play begins the "" .
